usageNotes: Permanently removes a custom CPU model definition from the cluster. The caller must hold Mapping.Modify on /mapping/cpu/{cputype}. Any VM or template already configured with this CPU type will retain the reference in its config but Proxmox will be unable to resolve the model on next start — remove or retype those VMs before deleting the model.
destructiveReason: The custom CPU model definition is permanently erased from the cluster; any VM referencing it will fail to start until its CPU type is updated.
tips: The 'custom-' prefix in the cputype value is optional — 'epyc-v4-tuned' and 'custom-epyc-v4-tuned' both resolve to the same model.
Check which VMs reference this model with get_cluster_qemu_custom_cpu_models or by scanning VM configs before deleting.
Returns null on success — no UPID is issued; the deletion is synchronous.
